$ printf 'one two\nthree four\nfive\n' | wc count
3 5 24
[exit 0]

$ printf 'one two\nthree four\nfive\n' | wc count --words
5
[exit 0]

$ printf 'one two\nthree four\nfive\n' | wc count -lc
3 24
[exit 0]

$ wc count --lines
0
[exit 0]

$ printf 'one two\nthree four\nfive\n' | wc count --chars
wc: count: unknown flag --chars
[exit 2]

$ printf 'one two\nthree four\nfive\n' | wc count >/dev/full
wc: main: write the numbers: transcript: no space left on device
[exit 1]
